correctness.rationale: For the exact 64-center, 128-target incidence system, directly checking each target verifies the 20-word witness. The 19-center infeasibility uses an exhaustive target-branching recursion. At every node a valid cover must select one of all centers containing the uncovered target, so every possible extension is explored; two coverage upper bounds safely prune. A compiled C++17 exact bitset replay exhausts 81,671 nodes with no 19-cover. Independent scipy MILP gives optimum 20; proof does not depend on solver logs or floating point. Boundary fixed to binary center length 6, one insertion.

value.rationale: Exact size for a natural length-six binary insertion-covering problem, at a first nontrivial finite scale with 64 centers and 128 requirements; naive sphere bound 16 is insufficient. A concrete near-modular optimum and complete finite obstruction replace an interval of possibilities. The fact is motivated by synchronization-error covering and provides an exact fixed-length calibration rather than a cosmetic parameter or downstream theorem claim.
